declarations.name: AuiTextInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI TextInput: `<aui-text-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Native input type. email and url add type validation.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the input.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Value is focusable and submitted but not editable.

inputs.name: minLength
inputs.description: Minimum length in code points.

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: Maximum length in code points (validated, not truncated).

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: HTML pattern semantics (anchored, v flag).

inputs.name: showCounter
inputs.description: Show remaining/over characters; requires maxLength.

inputs.name: autocomplete
inputs.description: Native autocomplete token. Password default: current-password.

inputs.name: inputMode
inputs.description: Virtual keyboard hint.

inputs.name: spellcheck
inputs.description: Default true for type text, false otherwise.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Text addon at the inline start.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.description: Text addon at the inline end.

inputs.name: revealable
inputs.description: Password inputs: show a reveal/hide toggle button.

inputs.name: clipboard
inputs.description: Clipboard policy for sensitive values.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Message and number-formatting locale.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

limitations: `maxLength` is validated, not enforced by truncation: users can paste long text and correct it (GOV.UK character-count pattern).
Lengths are counted in Unicode code points; grapheme clusters such as flag emoji count as more than one.
The clipboard policy is a deterrent, not a security boundary: browser extensions and developer tools can still read the value.
Input masking (phone, card numbers) is not available.
